run_wasm_spec_tests: run a WebAssembly .wast spec test file against the iwasm interpreter with optional AOT compilation
compile_wast_to_wasm: compile a .wast text format module to a .wasm binary using the wast2wasm tool
compile_wasm_to_aot: compile a .wasm module to an AOT binary for a target architecture like x86_64 or aarch64
parse_wast_forms: parse a WebAssembly .wast file string into a list of top-level S-expression forms
test_assert_return: test an assert_return form by invoking a WebAssembly function and comparing the return value
